Hi sarah jenkins,

Thank you for reaching out to technical support.

According to the Brilliant Directories documentation in [SSL / HTTPS FAQ](https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000665570-ssl-https-faq):

Article: SSL / HTTPS FAQ
Section: FAQ
Category: Solution home > Add-On Documentation

## FAQ


I already purchased an SSL Certificate from another provider, can I use this one instead?

Yes!  The can install their own certificate through cPanel (Admin area >> Developers >> cPanel Dashboard).  Once the admin has successfully installed their own certificate, simplysubmit a ticketrequesting that we enable all of the settings for their site to route traffic to HTTPS.

If I provide my own SSL Certificate, does this change the cost in any way?

There is no charge if the admin purchase and install their 3rd party SSL Certificate on theirown.  Please note that we cannot provide support for the self-installation of 3rd party SSL Certificates, but our Support Team is able to assist with any issues encountered with theSSL Security Add-Onpurchased directly through Brilliant Directories.

The domain has CAA records. Does anything need to change for the SSL certificate to install?

A CAA record is an optional DNS record that lists which certificate authorities are allowed to issue SSL certificates for a domain. Most domains have none, and nothing needs to be done. If the domain has any CAA records, one of them must allowsectigo.com, the certificate authority behind the certificates installed by the SSL Security Add-On. Without it, the certificate cannot be issued and the site stays on HTTP.

To fix this, add one more CAA record at the domain's DNS host, alongside the existing CAA records. Do not delete the existing ones:

Type:CAAName:@ (the root domain)Flag:0Tag:issueValue:sectigo.com

Once the record is saved, the certificate is issued automatically during the next nightly certificate check.

Can I use Brilliant Directories Credits for this service?

Yes, credits may be used to purchase this or any full-priced Add-On.

Source: [SSL / HTTPS FAQ](https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000665570-ssl-https-faq)

For more detailed step-by-step guidance, please review our official documentation:

• Where To Get Help & Support: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000649874-where-to-get-help-support
• Member Profile Analytics: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000619186-member-profile-analytics

Please let us know if you need any additional assistance.

Best regards,
Technical Consulting Team
